text:
rachel: Noticing cross-region TLS handshake failures starting ~02:14 UTC. Errors show TLS alert decrypt_error and x509: certificate signed by unknown authority for requests routed to ap-south1.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260405-03. Paging network oncall.
dani: Logs from edge-proxy show `GetCertificate error: no certificates found for SNI \"api.redwood.internal\"` and then `tls: handshake failure`. Any cert rotation happened recently?
rachel: Yes, we rotated intermediates in the global LB config at 01:50 UTC to switch to new vendor chain. The certs themselves were fine in us-west, but ap-south1 started rejecting because it didn't accept the new intermediate.
ashok: Could be an incomplete chain upload on the regional LB appliance. Ap-south1 is still v1.2 of the appliance agent (older openssl). It might not like the new cross-signed root.
ops-sre: Can we fail traffic to the healthy region until we fix chain? We should avoid user impact.
dani: Immediate mitigation: revert LB config to previous intermediate for ap-south1 only. Rolling a canary revert to ap-south1 now.
rachel: Revert applied to one node pair in ap-south1. Handshake success rate jumped from 62% to 99% on canary within 45s. Rolling region-wide revert.
oncall-bot: Deploy bot: revert-lb-config applied to ap-south1 (rev 20260405-17).
ashok: Confirmed: ap-south1 now serving prior chain and handshakes normalized. Kicking off postmortem and follow-ups.
ops-sre: Short-term action items:
- rollback applied (ops-sre) 1: done
- emergency cert chain replacement docs (networking) 1: in-progress
- add regional pre-flight compatibility checks (infra/agent) 1: assigned

rachel: Owners: Dani = remediation lead + rollback, Ashok = upstream vendor compatibility test & agent upgrade plan, Rachel = postmortem writeup + customer comms. Ops-sre to own runbook updates.
dani: Quick checklist for postmortem: timeline, root cause (partial chain not accepted by older openssl on region), why automation didn't catch it (no regional chain acceptance test), immediate mitigations, and corrective actions.
ashok: I'll validate the appliance openssl version matrix and vendor's chain requirements. If agent upgrades are required, propose rolling plan + compatibility gate. ETA: 2026-04-07 EOD.
ops-sre: Monitoring changes: add TLS handshake success metric by region + alarm if region handshake rate < 95% for 1m. Also add alert for cert chain validation failures during deploys.
rachel: I'll file PRs: infra runbook, customer ack template, and GA-compatible chain upload script that validates full chain locally before uploading.
networking: Suggest adding a canary + synthetic probe from each region that verifies SNI and full chain on every cert change: simple openssl s_client -servername and verify return code.
dani: Good call. Also add preflight step in deployment pipeline to run that probe. I'll update the deploy pipeline today.
ops-sre: Timeline: short-term (1h) revert = done. Mid-term (24-48h) - deploy preflight probes + alerts. Long-term (2w) - agent upgrade / chain compatibility tests; include vendor sign-off.
rachel: Schedule follow-up postmortem meeting tomorrow 2026-04-06 13:00 UTC. Oncall-bot set reminder.
oncall-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem meeting scheduled 2026-04-06 13:00 UTC.
ashok: Also important: scan other regions for appliances with older agent versions. I'll produce inventory by EOD.
networking: Customer impact note: small percentage of API requests from ap-south1 failed for ~18 minutes. Rachel will draft customer-facing comms after postmortem.
dani: Adding recurrence watch: monitor for 4 weeks and report weekly.
rachel: Postmortem draft plan: include timeline, RCA (incomplete chain + agent openssl incompat), mitigations, owners, automated preflight checklist, and schedule for follow-ups. Draft by EOD.
ops-sre: Runbook snippet added to incident doc with rollback command and validation steps.
networking: Will open infra PR with chain validator script and CI job that runs openssl verify against target agent matrix.
rachel: Thanks all. Closing for now, will update incident page with PR links post-meeting. :white_check_mark:
